__source__: https://github.com/bitburner-official/bitburner-src/blob/dev/src/Netscript/RamCostGenerator.ts (fetched 2026-07-19, re-verified directly against this source 2026-08-13 via the new ram-costs-refresh skill)
__note__: Covers core/general NS functions plus hacknet.* and ui.* and formulas.* (all near-future-likely for this repo per CLAUDE.md's early-game hack/grow/weaken + hacknet focus). Deliberately excludes the extended late-game subsystem APIs (corporation, bladeburner, sleeve, stanek, go, singularity, stock, codingcontract, infiltration, grafting, dnet) — referencing any of those will correctly surface as 'unknown cost' rather than a silent wrong number. singularity.* entries below are the deliberate exceptions, added as this repo started calling them; other singularity.* methods not yet listed remain unconfirmed and deliberately excluded. singularity.connect was confirmed in-game via `mem connect-to.js` (2026-07-20: 33.80GB total = 1.6 base + 0.2 scan + 32.0 connect) since this repo calls it from backdoor-loop.ts and connect-to.ts. getOwnedAugmentations/getFactionRep/getAugmentationsFromFaction/getAugmentationRepReq were added (2026-08-11) via ns-cost-lookup from NetscriptDefinitions.d.ts's documented remarks (not yet `mem`-verified) once augment-loop.ts and faction-work-loop.ts started calling them. donateToFaction was added (2026-08-13) the same way, once augment-loop.ts started calling it for favor-gated faction donations. All singularity.* values here are the conservative outside-BitNode-4-without-SF4 tier (documented as e.g. '2 GB * 16/4/1' -> 32 stored here) — same convention as singularity.connect's existing 32 — so ram-audit reports a safe upper bound; the actual in-game cost is the same or lower once native-BN4 or SF4 applies (see bitburner_bn4_singularity memory). cloud.* was added in full (2026-07-23) from NetscriptDefinitions.d.ts's documented `RAM cost:` remarks directly (not yet `mem`-verified in-game) once server-purchase-manager.ts/controller.ts/battlestation.ts started using it for purchased-server automation. gang.* was added in full (2026-07-30) from NetscriptDefinitions.d.ts's documented `RAM cost:` remarks, cross-checked and confirmed against `mem scripts/gang-manager.js` (37.20GB total matched exactly: 1.6 base + 0.5 getPlayer + the gang.* calls below + 1.10GB from two bare property-name collisions — see ram-audit SKILL.md 'Known false negatives' #3). 2026-08-13 ram-costs-refresh run (this skill's own smoke test): cross-checked every existing entry directly against RamCostGenerator.ts for the first time (previously most were only checked against NetscriptDefinitions.d.ts's doc comments, which are generated from the same source but hadn't been compared to it directly) — zero drift found across every namespace, including cloud.* which is now confirmed rather than just d.ts-sourced. Also added 19 further singularity.* entries (getAugmentationPrice, installAugmentations, purchaseAugmentation, checkFactionInvitations, getCurrentWork, joinFaction, stopAction, workForFaction, getCurrentServer, installBackdoor, upgradeHomeCores, getDarkwebPrograms, purchaseProgram, purchaseTor, upgradeHomeRam, applyToCompany, workForCompany, commitCrime, getCrimeChance) found via ram-audit's 'unknown cost' output and confirmed against both RamCostGenerator.ts and NetscriptDefinitions.d.ts (exact agreement); corporation.*/dnet.* 'unknown cost' hits from that same run were deliberately left alone per this note's existing exclusion policy. Re-derive this whole file from the same RamCostGenerator.ts source whenever NetscriptDefinitions.d.ts is re-fetched for a game-version bump, and extend it if this repo grows into one of the still-excluded subsystems. 2026-08-30 update: the singularity.* block above was re-scaled from the conservative "outside-BitNode-4-without-SF4" 16x tier down to the native 1x tier (divided every existing singularity.* value by 16) - see [[bitburner_singularity_ram_tier_stale]] memory. This repo's SF4.3 is now permanent (confirmed same day), which makes the 1x/native multiplier apply forever regardless of BitNode, so the old 16x "safe upper bound" was overstating every singularity-referencing script's real cost by 16x. Cross-checked against controller.ts's own historical live-mem comments (e.g. crime-loop.js measured 11.60GB live == 1.6 base + 5 getCrimeChance + 5 commitCrime, all native tier) - exact match. Re-derive this block again if SF4.3 is ever lost/reset or a game-version bump changes the underlying RamCostGenerator.ts constants.
